verdict.rationale: Discord's own blog documents Threads as a way to branch a conversation off a channel's main feed while keeping it in the channel, and says Private Threads are available to all servers on desktop and mobile. That covers the core of keeping side discussions attached. missing for 10: explicit documentation that a thread is anchored to a specific originating message, detail on admin-side thread management or permissions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can reply in threads so side discussions stay attached to the original message

citations.quote: A Thread is a quick way to branch a conversation off of a channel’s main feed without removing it from the channel itself.
Private Threads are now available for all servers!
